newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 70 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 70 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated March 28 to commercial banks worth 70 billion Lebanese pounds ($45.4 million).
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 68 billion pounds at 12.75 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds at 12 percent.
Last week the bank sold 60-day CDs worth 85 billion pounds and 45-day CDs worth eight billion pounds at the same interest rates.
